name: OmniPulse Chatbot
author: OmniPulse
description: OmniPulse's own chatbot. Song requests, alerts, your own actions and OBS controls, straight from your chat, with no other bot needed. Works with Twitch and Kick, and YouTube is coming.

settings.label: Twitch Client ID
settings.note: Your own, from dev.twitch.tv/console/apps: Register Your Application, any name, OAuth Redirect URL http://localhost, category Chat Bot, Client Type Public. Then copy its Client ID here.

settings.label: Your Channel
settings.note: Your own Twitch account, for your chat and its events (follows, subs, bits, raids...).

settings.label: Your Channel, Another Browser
settings.note: The sign-in link copied instead, to open where you like.

settings.label: Bot Account (optional)
settings.note: A second Twitch account that posts the replies. Without one, they come from your channel.

settings.label: Bot Account, Another Browser
settings.note: Paste it into a private window and sign in as the bot there. You stay signed in to your own account in your normal browser.

settings.label: Sign Out
settings.note: Forgets both sign-ins on this PC.

settings.label: Kick
settings.note: The chatbot also answers your Kick chat, with song requests, your actions and alerts.

settings.label: Kick Channel
settings.note: The name in your kick.com address. It's filled in when you sign in.

settings.label: Kick Client ID
settings.note: Your own Kick app. On kick.com, open Settings > Developer and click Create App. Set its Redirect URL to http://localhost:8476/kick and tick all its scopes. Then copy its Client ID here.

settings.label: Kick Client Secret
settings.note: From the same app.

settings.label: Kick Sign-In
settings.note: Your Kick account. The chatbot answers as you.

settings.label: Kick, Another Browser
settings.note: Copies the sign-in link instead. Open it in a private window on this PC.

settings.label: Kick Bot Account (optional)
settings.note: A second Kick account that posts the replies, through the same Kick app. Without one, they come from your channel.

settings.label: Kick Bot, Another Browser
settings.note: Paste it into a private window on this PC and sign in as the bot there. You stay signed in to your own account in your normal browser.

settings.label: Kick Sign Out
settings.note: Forgets both Kick sign-ins on this PC.

settings.label: Actions
settings.note: What your chatbot does and when. Each action has a trigger (a command, a message, an event, a timer or the music), then steps that run in order.

settings.label: Points
settings.note: Your own currency, like Mix It Up's. Viewers earn some for chatting while you're live, and spend them in your actions.

settings.label: Points' Name
settings.note: What they're called in chat (%pointsname%).

settings.label: Points Each Time
settings.note: For each viewer who's chatted since the last time.

settings.label: Every
settings.note: Minutes.

settings.label: Ranks
settings.note: Points, then the rank's name, with commas between: %rank% in an action is a viewer's.

settings.label: Points While Offline Too
settings.note: When this is off, viewers only earn points while you're live.

settings.label: OBS
settings.note: Your actions can switch scenes, show or hide sources, and more. In OBS, open Tools > WebSocket Server Settings, tick Enable WebSocket server, and enter its password below.

settings.label: OBS Address
settings.note: Where OBS's WebSocket server is (this PC, its port).

settings.label: OBS Password
settings.note: From the same place in OBS (Show Connect Info).

settings.label: Streamlabs Donations
settings.note: Your Socket API Token. On streamlabs.com, open Settings > API Settings > API Tokens. Donations then start A Donation actions and show as alerts. Leave it empty to turn this off.

settings.label: StreamElements Tips
settings.note: Your JWT Token. On streamelements.com, open your account's Channels page and click Show Secrets. Leave it empty to turn this off.

settings.label: Song Requests
settings.note: !sr (or !request) and a song, !song for what's playing, !wrongsong to take back your last one. Uses Settings > Streaming > Song Requests' limits and replies.

settings.label: Alerts
settings.note: Follows, subs, resubs, gifts, bits, raids, hype trains and polls, to your alerts on the Stream Widget.

settings.label: Request Commands
settings.note: With commas between.

settings.label: Your Commands (the Old Way)
settings.default: !discord = Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/yours; !socials = Find me everywhere as @me
settings.note: These move into Actions the first time you open Actions. Until then, write each one as "!name = its reply".
